name: Miya
title: The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonl...
summary: The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonlit Forest.

skills.name: Moon Blessing
skills.description:
Each time Miya's Basic Attack hits a target, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s (up to 5 stacks).

At maximum stacks, each Basic Attack also summons a Moonlight Shadow to attack the target, dealing 25 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 20% Attack Effects.
skills.notes: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

skills.name: Moon Arrow
skills.description:
Miya's Basic Attacks shoot 2 extra Split Arrows, each inheriting 30% of Attack Effects. They deal 10 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the primary target and 30% damage to other targets.

This effect lasts 4s.
skills.notes: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

skills.name: Arrow of Eclipse
skills.description:
Miya calls upon the power of Moon Eclipse in the target area, dealing 270 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

The attack then splits into 6 arrows that scatter in different directions. Each arrow deals 40 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2s.
skills.notes: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

skills.name: Hidden Moonlight
skills.description:
Miya removes all debuffs and enters the Conceal state, gaining 65% Movement Speed for up to 2s (attacking ends the state early).

Upon exiting the Conceal state, Miya gains maximum stacks of Moon Blessing.
skills.notes: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

story.biography:
The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonlit Forest.Combat Doctrine:
Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

Matchup Intelligence:
Miya counters heroes who rely on targeted CC effects, such as Saber and Eudora, because she can easily escape their CC and respond with a strong counterattack. The split arrows from her 1st Skill are also very effective against heroes that summon units, such as Sun. Miya is countered by heroes with a lot of AOE damage, such as Pharsa and Yve, because they can still hit her while she is concealed.
story.personality: Renowned Marksman specializing in Finisher, Damage across the Gold lane.
quotes: The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonlit Forest.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Gold Lane.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30 (+1.3% Max HP) (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times.

Each hit reduces the target's by 5% (up to 40%).
skills.notes: Balmond is best with Support heroes that can boost his Mobility and Survivability. Examples include Angela and Rafaela.

skills.name: Lethal Counter

Damage dealt to non-hero units is capped at 1000 True Damage.

summary: A swordsman in pursuit of invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718.

skills.notes: Saber works well with high-damage heroes who can help him burst down enemy heroes in teamfights, such as Kadita and Cyclops.

skills.name: Orbiting Swords

skills.notes: Saber works well with high-damage heroes who can help him burst down enemy heroes in teamfights, such as Kadita and Cyclops.

skills.name: Triple Sweep
skills.description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). name: Alice
title: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominan...
summary: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers in the Abyss.

skills.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
skills.description:
Alice gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson each time her skill hits an enemy, lasting 4s (up to 2 stacks). Blood Banquet activates at max stacks.

Blood Banquet: Every 0.5s, Alice deals 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+ 0.5% - 2.5% target's , scaling with level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. She also recovers 10 (+3% Extra Max HP) HP and gains 8% Movement Speed. Its duration is refreshed when her skills hit an enemy hero.
Damage to creeps is capped at 70 (+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage.
skills.notes: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

skills.name: Crimson Gleam
skills.description:
Alice shoots Blood Energy forward, dealing 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.

Use Again: Before Blood Energy dissipates, Alice can recast this skill as Scarlet Shadow to blink to its location.
skills.notes: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

skills.name: Doom Waltz
skills.description:
Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s.

If Blood Banquet is active, the skill also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of Blood Banquet's damage and recovering the same amount of HP.
skills.notes: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

skills.name: Throne of Ruin
skills.description:
Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%.

After 1.5s, she descends from above, dealing 500 (+200% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.

While charging her Ultimate, Alice cannot use any hero skills other than Scarlet Shadow.
skills.notes: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

story.biography:
Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers in the Abyss.Combat Doctrine:
To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

Matchup Intelligence:
With her great sustainability in combat plus her mobility and CC, Alice counters heroes that lack burst and can't escape from melee enemies, such as Cecilion and Chang'e. Alice is countered by heroes with Execute or Healing Reduction who can impede her from healing herself during the Ultimate. Heroes like Baxia or Martis can reduce her healing or kill her before she can heal.
story.personality: Renowned Tank/Mage specializing in Charge, Regen across the EXP/Jungle lane.
quotes: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers in the Abyss.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the EXP Lane.

name: Nana
title: Little Leonin with no worries.
summary: Little Leonin with no worries.

skills.name: Molina's Gift
skills.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Molina's Gift removes all debuffs from Nana and transforms her for 2s. While transformed, Nana is immune to all damage, gains 30% Movement Speed, and recovers 10% per second, but cannot cast skills.
This effect can trigger only once every 150s.
skills.notes: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

skills.name: Magic Boomerang
skills.description:
Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it hits as it travels out and returns.

The first enemy hit takes full damage. Damage is reduced by 10% each additional enemy hit, up to a maximum total reduction of 70%.
skills.notes: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

skills.name: Molina Smooch
skills.description:
Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within range and Transforming enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, Transforming the first enemy hero she touches.

Transform: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.
skills.notes: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

skills.name: Molina Blitz
skills.description:
Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each dealing 440 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies in the area by 30% for 1s.

Consecutive hits from Molina Blitz on the same enemy stun them for 1s.
skills.notes: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

story.biography:
Little Leonin with no worries.Combat Doctrine:
Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

Matchup Intelligence:
Nana's Passive gives her great survivability, making her strong against heroes with deadly combos, like Eudora and Kadita. Nana can be countered by heroes with strong chasing abilities, like Zilong, Natalia, because they can chase Nana through her Passive duration.
story.personality: Renowned Mage specializing in Poke, Burst across the Mid lane.
quotes: Little Leonin with no worries.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Mid Lane.

build.tips: Nana's Passive gives her great survivability, making her strong against heroes with deadly combos, like Eudora and Kadita. Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

name: Tigreal
title: Warrior of Dawn
summary: Commander of the Moniyan Empire's Imperial Knights. An unyielding frontline Vanguard capable of displacing entire enemy teams and locking them down with AoE stun chains.

skills.name: Fearless
skills.description: Tigreal gains a stack of Blessing each time he casts a skill or is hit by a Basic Attack (including Turret shots). At 4 stacks, Tigreal consumes all stacks to completely negate the next incoming Basic Attack or Turret hit.
skills.notes: Works against empowered basic attacks and tower shots, enabling aggressive level-2 and level-4 turret dives.

skills.name: Attack Wave
skills.description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer, firing three shockwaves in a fan-shaped direction. Enemies caught in the path take Physical Damage and are slowed by up to 45% for 1.5s based on how many waves hit them.
skills.notes: Cast Attack Wave immediately after Sacred Hammer airborne knockup to guarantee all three wave bursts hit point-blank.

skills.name: Sacred Hammer
skills.description: Tigreal charges in a target direction and pushes enemies along his path, dealing Physical Damage. Within 4s after finishes charging, he can cast this skill again to smash the ground and knock enemies airborne for 0.6s.
skills.notes: Can push enemy jungler buffs out of their camp perimeter to reset creep patience.

skills.name: Implosion
skills.description: Tigreal channels the power of the Light, pulling surrounding enemies toward him while stunning them, then slams his shield into the ground for 270–430 Physical Damage and a 1.5s stun.
skills.notes: Signature combo: Cast Implosion, then trigger Flicker mid-channel before the pull completes for an unreactable instant AoE pull.

story.biography:
Born into the prestigious House Wertz of the Moniyan Empire, Tigreal swore his life to the Lord of Light at a young age. Rising to Commander of the Light's Order, he led the Imperial Knights in countless campaigns against the Abyssal demons in the Barren Lands.

Though once branded a coward after refusing a suicidal charge to save his men during the Second Siege of the Imperial Sanctuary, Tigreal returned from self-exile stronger and wiser. Alongside his younger sister Fanny, he remains the unbreakable shield of Lumini City.
story.personality: Stoic, honorable, protective, and self-sacrificing. Never retreats while a single comrade stands behind him.
quotes: A real man never hides in the bush!
Horns of war sound! The Knights of Light assemble!
Honor is everything to a Knight of the Empire.

build.tips: Hide in river bushes to mask your line of sight, use Implosion + Flicker into grouped carries, and immediately follow with Sacred Hammer back toward your allies.

loreLinks.relation: Former Comrade in the Light's Order

name: Fanny
title: Blade Dancer
summary: A fearless aerial assassin who grapples across terrain walls with twin steel cables, dealing devastating burst damage the faster she flies.

skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.description: According to her flying speed, Fanny's damage while flying is increased by 10% to 20% and applies a Prey Marker to enemy heroes (up to 2 stacks). Damaging an enemy with a Prey Marker restores 7 Energy per stack.
skills.notes: Purple Buff (Thunder Fenrir) reduces Energy cost dramatically and is mandatory for sustained multi-cable teamfights.

skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.description: Fanny whirls her twin blades, dealing Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Automatically triggers on impact when she collides with an enemy hero during Steel Cable flight.
skills.notes: Each mid-air wall cable reset allows another Tornado Strike proc if energy permits.

skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.description: Fanny throws out a cable that draws her to the first obstacle it hits. Each successive cable cast within 2s reduces its Energy cost by 2. If energy is sufficient, colliding with an enemy triggers Tornado Strike.
skills.notes: Two simultaneous cables adjust her flight vector to the midpoint between both anchor walls.

skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.description: Fanny initiates a quick attack on an enemy, dealing massive Physical Damage. Each stack of Prey Marker on the target increases this damage by 20%.
skills.notes: Wait for 2 stacks of Prey Marker from a cable pass + Tornado Strike before pressing Cut Throat to maximize +40% bonus execute damage.

story.biography:
Despite being humans unable to fly, Fanny refused to accept the limits imposed by her noble upbringing in House Wertz. Designing twin grappling hooks and dual blades tailored for high-altitude combat, she conquered the treacherous cliffs surrounding the Moniyan Empire.

While her brother Tigreal guards the frontlines on the ground, Fanny patrols the skies, striking down Abyssal infiltrators before they ever see her shadow.
story.personality: Rebellious, daring, competitive, and fiercely independent.
quotes: Sir, what's your command? Haha, just kidding!
Birds yearn for the sky, and so do I.
Wait for me, brother! I'll clear the skies!

build.tips: Prioritize flat Physical Penetration (Heptaseas + Malefic Roar + BoD) for a one-pass assassination build, then transition into defensive items so CC doesn't instantly delete you.

name: Layla
title: Energy Gunner
summary: Iconic Eruditio Ranger wielding the Malefic Gun. Gains the longest Basic Attack range in the entire game at level 12 and deals up to 130% scaled damage at max distance.

skills.name: Malefic Gun
skills.description: The damage of Layla's Basic Attacks and skills scales with the distance between her and the enemy, from 100% up to 130% at 6 yards.
skills.notes: Can outrange Turrets at max Malefic Bomb + Ultimate level without taking turret aggro!

skills.name: Malefic Bomb
skills.description: Layla fires a Malefic Energy Bomb forward. Upon hitting an enemy, her Basic Attack range increases for 3s and she gains 60% Movement Speed decaying over 1.2s (doubled if hitting an enemy hero).
skills.notes: Landing Malefic Bomb is your primary kiting and spacing tool.

skills.name: Void Projectile
skills.description: Layla fires an energy ball that explodes, dealing Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies while applying a Magic Mark. Triggering the mark with an attack stuns nearby enemies for 0.25s and slows them.
skills.notes: The micro-stun interrupts enemy channels and buys time to kite backwards.

skills.name: Destruction Rush
skills.description: Layla fires an energy blast with extreme range, dealing 500–800 Physical Damage to enemies in a line. Passively increases the range of Void Projectile and her Basic Attacks by 0.6 – 1.8 yards.
skills.notes: At Level 3 Ultimate, Layla becomes a walking artillery cannon behind her frontline Tank.

story.biography: Daughter of Nolan and Lilian—pioneering scientists of Eruditio who vanished into the multiverse cosmic rifts—Layla was raised by her grandfather with a fierce desire to protect her city. Armed with the Leviathan Workshop's Malefic Cannon, she leads the Eruditio Rangers.
story.personality: Optimistic, energetic, courageous, and determined to live up to her parents' legacy.
quotes: Time to shine!
Keep it up, until you're as brilliant as me!
We can do it!

build.tips: Combine Layla's innate range with the item Malefic Gun to hit enemies from off-screen in late-game sieges.

name: Minotaur

summary: Minoan prince determined to restore his homeland.

Enraged State: Motivation HP recovery is increased to 200%.

The first 2 hits deal 180 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200 (+85% Total Physical Attack) True Damage and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The Enraged state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

skills.notes: In order for Freya to maximize her damage, she prefers heroes with CC like Belerick and Gatotkaca to lock down the enemy for her.

title: An assassin exiled by the Empire.
summary: An assassin exiled by the Empire.

name: Kagura

summary: Heir to the Seimei Umbrella of the Cadia Riverlands. Alternates between Umbrella Open and Closed stances for 6 total spell casts, built-in Purify, and devastating AoE burst.

skills.name: Yin Yang Gathering
skills.description: Whenever the Seimei Umbrella and Kagura become one, she gains a shield absorbing 280 (+50% Total Magic Power) damage, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5s, and slows them by 60% for 1s.
skills.notes: Triggered both by walking over the umbrella or blinking to it with Rasho Umbrella Flee.

skills.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
skills.description: Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to a target location, dealing Magic Damage to enemies along its path and slowing them by 60% for 1s. The umbrella grants bush vision where it rests.
skills.notes: Always use Seimei Umbrella Open to scout bushes rather than face-checking.

skills.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
skills.description: With Umbrella: Removes all crowd control debuffs (except Suppression) and dashes in a direction, leaving the umbrella behind. Without Umbrella: Teleports directly to the umbrella and deals Magic Damage.
skills.notes: Built-in Purify lets Kagura escape Franco hooks, Tigreal implosions, and Guinevere knockups.

skills.name: Yin Yang Overturn
skills.description: Without Umbrella: Resets Skill 1 cooldown, links nearby enemies to the umbrella, and pulls them inward after 1.5s for massive Magic Damage. With Umbrella: Knocks nearby enemies back and slows them.
skills.notes: Full combo: S1 (place umbrella) -> Ult (pull link) -> S1 (reposition umbrella onto escaping enemy) -> S2 (teleport to umbrella + stun) -> Ult (knockback burst) -> S2 (dash out safely).

story.biography: Descended from the Great Seimei, legendary Onmyouji of the Cadia Riverlands, Kagura grew up alongside Hayabusa of the Shadow Sect. When Hayabusa departed on a deadly mission to hunt the traitor Hanzo, Kagura secretly took the sacred Seimei Umbrella—a relic housing a hundred spirits—and followed him into the Land of Dawn.
story.personality: Cheerful, spirited, loyal to Hayabusa, and deceptively wise in spiritual arts.
quotes: Seimei Umbrella, at your service!
Think twice before you underestimate a girl with an umbrella.
Yin and Yang, two sides of the same coin.

build.tips: Use Skill 1 cooldown reset on Ultimate (Open stance) to move the umbrella right before the 1.5s pull snaps shut.

name: Chou
title: Kung Fu Boy
summary: Master of Jeet Kune Do who weaves triple combos, CC-immune dashes, and his iconic Way of Dragon roundhouse kick to isolate priority targets.

skills.name: Only Fast
skills.description: After every 8 yards Chou moves, his next Basic Attack deals 180% of Total Physical Attack, slows the target by 80% briefly, and reduces their Physical Defense by 10 (up to 2 stacks).
skills.notes: Dashing with Jeet Kune Do and Shunpo rapidly charges the 8-yard distance meter.

skills.name: Jeet Kune Do
skills.description: Chou punches forward up to 3 times in succession. The 3rd phase knocks surrounding enemies airborne for 0.8s and resets the cooldown of Shunpo (Skill 2) if it hits an enemy hero.
skills.notes: Pre-cast the first two phases in a bush, then use Shunpo or Flicker to land the 3rd airborne slam instantly on enemy carries.

skills.name: Shunpo
skills.description: Chou dashes a short distance, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects during the dash and gaining a shield absorbing 200–350 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) damage.
skills.notes: Time Shunpo right as enemy stuns or hooks connect to completely negate the CC.

skills.name: The Way of Dragon
skills.description: Chou delivers a roundhouse kick to knock an enemy hero far back, dealing 400–500 Physical Damage. Cast again to chase the enemy in mid-air and unleash a flurry of kicks dealing at least 400–500 Physical Damage.
skills.notes: Wait 0.8s before pressing the second phase of Ultimate to maximize distance kicked toward your turret or teammates.

story.biography: Raised in poverty in a remote slum, Chou saved the life of a dying Buddhist monk hunted by mercenaries. In gratitude, the monk imparted the ancient secrets of Jeet Kune Do to the boy and charged him with uprooting evil across the Land of Dawn.
story.personality: Humble yet flashy, fiercely righteous, and always ready for a sparring match.
quotes: In the world of Kung Fu, speed defines the winner!
Wipe out all the injustice in the world!
Not knowing oneself—that is the worst.

build.tips: Can be played full Tank Roamer (pick-off initiator) or Full Damage EXP Assassin (Heptaseas + BoD + Malefic Roar).

Demonic Slash cannot Crit, but can still trigger Crit-related effects.
skills.notes: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

skills.notes: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

Meteoric Sword counts as a Basic Attack and can trigger Attack Effects. Attack Speed shortens the charge time.
skills.notes: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

skills.notes: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

skills.notes: Bounces off enemy heroes, minions, and even Odette herself when only two targets are present.

skills.name: Avian Authority
skills.description: Odette concentrates energy to summon a swan to attack enemies, dealing Magic Damage and slowing them by 70% for 2s.
skills.notes: High 150% Magic Power scaling makes it a potent long-range poke tool.

skills.description: Odette releases a magic energy ball forward that immobilizes the first enemy hit for 1.5s, then splits to hit a second nearby enemy or terrain and immobilize them as well.
skills.notes: Can immobilize two enemy heroes at once to set up an unmissable Swan Song.

skills.name: Swan Song
skills.description: Odette chants a song that summons a massive field of energy for 5s, gaining a 1400–1800 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and immunity to basic slows/displacement. She can cast Swan Song again to dash inside the concerto without interrupting it.
skills.notes: Can activate Winter Crown (Freeze) during Swan Song without cancelling the damaging AoE channel!

story.biography: Born on the banks of Regina Lake as the thirteenth generation heir to Swan Castle, Odette was blessed by the swans at birth. When the wounded Baroque swordsman Lancelot washed ashore after being ambushed, Odette nursed him back to health—sparking a romance that bridged two rival noble houses.
story.personality: Graceful, serene, compassionate, and unwavering in love.
quotes: Have you ever seen the sunrise over Swan Lake?
Swordsmanship and magic—two arts that dance together.
May the swans guide your heart home.

build.tips: Combo with Tigreal's Implosion and pop Winter Crown mid-Swan Song if an enemy tries to stun you out of your channel.

summary: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.

skills.description: Diggie marks an enemy hero for 4s. When the duration ends—or immediately if the target attempts to leave the circle—they are yanked back to the center mark and take Magic Damage.

skills.name: Time Journey
skills.description: Diggie removes all debuffs from nearby allied heroes, grants a massive shield, +50% Movement Speed briefly, and complete Crowd Control Immunity for 3s!
skills.notes: The ultimate draft counter against Tigreal, Khufra, Atlas, and Guinevere engage compositions.

story.biography: Beneath his diminutive owl feathers, Diggie is Eruditio's foremost chronomancer. Using his Temporal Nest clockwork apparatus, he can rewind localized pockets of spacetime—saving Eruditio citizens from fatal accidents and turning back the clock on catastrophic battles.
story.personality: Scholarly, eccentric, cheerful, and obsessed with punctuality.
quotes: Time is science! Tick-tock, tick-tock!
A star will disappear if you lose!
Let's rewind that mistake, shall we?

build.tips: Save Time Journey exclusively for the enemy Roamer's engage (e.g., the instant Tigreal blinks in for Implosion).

skills.description: Each time Angela casts a skill, her Movement Speed increases by 7.5% (up to 30%) for 4s. When she is attached to an allied hero, the attached ally also gains this Movement Speed bonus.

skills.description: Angela sends Love Energy in a target direction, dealing Magic Damage to enemies, applying a Lover's Mark stack (increasing damage taken by 20% per stack and slowing by 8%), and healing allies hit.

skills.description: Angela launches a puppet string at the target enemy, gradually slowing them up to 80%. If the target remains connected after 3s, they are immobilized for 1.5s and take bonus Magic Damage increased by 20% per Lover's Mark.

skills.name: Heartguard

skills.notes: Building high Magic Power + Fleeting Time turns Heartguard into a 3000+ HP shield every ~25 seconds.

story.biography: Created by Dr. Baker, co-founder of Laboratory 1718, Angela was built without weapons or human flesh—instead endowed with a synthetic soul capable of genuine empathy. When Dr. Alpha's ruthless experiments corrupted Lab 1718, Dr. Baker placed Angela in an escape capsule and sent her toward Eruditio.
story.personality: Kind-hearted, optimistic, curious, and protective of her companions.
quotes: Dr. Baker gave me a heart, and I'll use it to protect you!
Papapa~ Puppet on a string!
Love and hope are the two greatest inventions.

build.tips: Constantly watch the mini-map portraits to cast Heartguard BEFORE your diving assassin or fighter gets burst down.

name: Gusion
title: Holy Blade
summary: Rebellious fourth son of House Paxley who fuses light magic with lightning-fast throwing daggers, capable of summoning and recalling 10 blades in a split second.

skills.name: Dagger Specialist
skills.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4). His next Basic Attack consumes all runes to deal additional Magic Damage equal to 4% of the target's missing HP per stack and restores HP equal to 50 (+25% Total Magic Power) per stack.
skills.notes: Weaving an empowered basic attack after your 10-dagger recall deals lethal missing-HP execution damage.

skills.name: Sword Spike
skills.description: Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing Magic Damage and marking the first enemy hit. Cast again to blink behind the marked enemy and deal heavy Magic Damage.
skills.notes: Recalling Shadowblade Slaughter daggers while blinking to the marked enemy guarantees all 5 (or 10) returning blades pierce straight through the target.

skills.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
skills.description: Gusion throws 5 daggers forward in a fan pattern, each dealing Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 6% (stacks up to 30%). Use again to recall all daggers to his current position.
skills.notes: Point-blank shotgun casts hit a single enemy with all 5 outgoing blades and all 5 returning blades.

skills.name: Incandescence
skills.description: Gusion dashes to a target location, immediately refreshing the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. Can be cast a second time within 4s to perform a short hop.
skills.notes: If Shadowblade Slaughter was thrown before casting Incandescence, you can throw a second set of 5 daggers and recall all 10 daggers simultaneously.

story.biography:
House Paxley is one of the most revered mage lineages in the Moniyan Empire, demanding absolute devotion to traditional incantations. Yet Gusion, fourth son of the patriarch, detested slow chanting and instead infused light magic into tempered steel daggers.

Cast out by his elders after defying family ritual in the Tournament of Aberleen, Gusion now wanders the Land of Dawn to prove that speed and steel surpass archaic dogma.
story.personality: Cocky, agile, defiant of authority, yet secretly protective of those he respects.
quotes: Break the limits!
The perfect combination of speed and strength.
Forget the magic incantations—watch my blades.

build.tips: Standard 10-dagger combo: S2 -> Ult -> S2 -> S1 (mark) -> S1 (dash behind target while recalling all 10 daggers) -> Empowered Basic Attack.

loreLinks.relation: Older Brother & Head of House Paxley

summary: Naughty and cute disciple of the Great Dragon.

skills.name: Trouble Maker
skills.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them that reduces their Movement Speed by 1% (up to 20%).
skills.notes: Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

skills.name: Starmoon Shockwave
skills.description:
Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5s.

Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon sends 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage and slowing enemies hit. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).
skills.notes: Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

skills.name: Crescent Moon
skills.description:
Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 10% Movement Speed until the shield is broken. Each time she casts a skill, she gains an extra 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.
Crescent Moon: Enhances her Basic Attacks to deal 20 (+35% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage 2 times.

Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks or skills, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.2s.
skills.notes: Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.description:
Chang'e gains 10% Movement Speed for 4s. During this time, she fires 30 meteors in the target direction, each dealing 60 (+21% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to minions and creeps.

Crescent Moon: Fires meteors alongside Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.
skills.notes: Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

story.biography:
Naughty and cute disciple of the Great Dragon.Combat Doctrine:
Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

Matchup Intelligence:
Chang'e is strong against squishy heroes who have low mobility and short damage range, such as Eudora and Odette. Chang'e can easily hit them with her long-range skills while dodging their attacks. Chang'e is countered by agile Assassins with high burst like Hanzo and Harley, as they can avoid Chang'e's skills and use their high burst damage to kill her since she lacks self-protection.
story.personality: Renowned Mage specializing in Poke, Burst across the Mid lane.
quotes: Naughty and cute disciple of the Great Dragon.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Mid Lane.

build.tips: Chang'e is strong against squishy heroes who have low mobility and short damage range, such as Eudora and Odette. Chang'e can easily hit them with her long-range skills while dodging their attacks. name: Kaja
title: Leader of Nazar who guards the Celestial Palace.
summary: Leader of Nazar who guards the Celestial Palace.

skills.name: Wings of Lightning
skills.description: Kaja's skill damage applies the Paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5s.
skills.notes: He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

skills.name: Ring of Order
skills.description:
Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him.
Enemies hit take 160 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and recover 78 (+45% Total Magic Power) HP to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.
skills.notes: He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

skills.name: Soaring Wings
skills.description:
Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5s, then enters the Soaring state.

The Soaring state lasts 6.6s. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing 100 (+25% Total Magic Power) (+ 2% target's ) Magic Damage to surrounding enemies.

Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings is reduced to 4s (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting a hero or creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6s.
skills.notes: He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

skills.name: Divine Binding
skills.description:
Kaja hurls a Primal Lightning Lasso at the target area. After a 0.5s delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take 360 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are trapped for 2.5s.

While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).
skills.notes: He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

story.biography:
Leader of Nazar who guards the Celestial Palace.Combat Doctrine:
He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

Matchup Intelligence:
Kaja does well against carries with no mobility skills, such as Layla, Ixia, and Vexana. Once he flies in and lassoes them, there's no hope of escape. Now, if you're up against Kaja, remember that while his Ultimate can't be Purified, heroes with mobility like Kagura, Yi Sun-shin, and Suyou can still dodge it with a dash.
story.personality: Renowned Support specializing in Initiator, Charge across the Roam lane.
quotes: Leader of Nazar who guards the Celestial Palace.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Roam Lane.

build.tips: Kaja does well against carries with no mobility skills, such as Layla, Ixia, and Vexana. Once he flies in and lassoes them, there's no hope of escape. He also pairs well with allies with AoE, like Odette, Pharsa, and Ixia. Kaja can hold enemies in place while they pile on the damage. The perfect set!

name: Selena
title: Dark Elf girl who fell into the Abyss.
summary: Dark Elf girl who fell into the Abyss.

skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.description:
Selena can switch freely between her two forms.
Elven Form: Selena applies Abyssal Mark when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8s and can stack up to 2 times.
Abyssal Form: Selena's Basic Attacks become melee and deal (+25% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage. Her skills deal 240-450 (+40% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage to enemies with Abyssal Mark and consume their mark stacks by 1. This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps and Minions.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Abyssal Trap
skills.description:
Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of Abyssal Mark and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s.

Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%.

Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Abyssal Arrow
skills.description:
Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance).

The wraith will pick up Abyssal Trap as it travels over it and will apply the trap to the enemy target upon stunning them.

If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Primal Darkness
skills.description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 .
Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Soul Eater and Garotte.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.description:
Selena strengthens her claws with the power of the Abyss, causing the next Basic Attack to dash to a target and deal an additional 200 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while granting her a 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield.

If this damage detonates an Abyssal Mark, Garotte's cooldown will reset.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Garotte
skills.description:
Selena charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path.

If this skill's damage detonates an Abyssal Mark, its cooldown will reset.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

skills.name: Blessing of the Moon Goddess
skills.description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 .
Active: Selena enters Elven Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Abyssal Trap and Abyssal Arrow.
skills.notes: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

story.biography:
Dark Elf girl who fell into the Abyss.Combat Doctrine:
Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

Matchup Intelligence:
Selena is strong against squishy heroes with poor Mobility, simply because it's hard for them to dodge her 2nd Skill. Such as Gord and Layla. But Selena is weak against heroes that can resist or remove her CC abilities, such as Hanabi and Wanwan.
story.personality: Renowned Assassin/Mage specializing in Initiator, Finisher across the Mid lane.
quotes: Dark Elf girl who fell into the Abyss.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Mid Lane.

build.tips: Selena is strong against squishy heroes with poor Mobility, simply because it's hard for them to dodge her 2nd Skill. Such as Gord and Layla. Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

name: Aldous
title: The guardian of the Minoan Labyrinth.
summary: The guardian of the Minoan Labyrinth.

skills.name: Contract: Transform
skills.description: Every 8s, Aldous gains a shield equal to 350 (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) for 3s on his next Basic Attack. He also gains 60% Movement Speed for 1s.
skills.notes: Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

skills.name: Contract: Soul Steal
skills.description:
Aldous enhances his next Basic Attack to deal 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) Physical Damage.

Killing a siege minion with this attack grants 12 Soul Steal stacks; killing any other non-hero unit grants 5 stacks. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra 5 stack(s), while killing one grants 12 (up to 1000 stacks).

This attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to minions and creeps. Aldous also gains 6 stack(s) when allied units eliminate a nearby enemy siege minion, and 2 stack(s) when they eliminate any other nearby non-hero unit.

Aldous gains 20% Movement Speed while moving toward enemy heroes during this skill.
skills.notes: Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

skills.name: Contract: Explosion
skills.description:
Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction for 2s or until canceled.
He then deals 200 (+20% Total Physical Attack)-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5-1s (scales with defensive stance duration).
skills.notes: Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

skills.name: Contract: Chase Fate
skills.description:
Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5s.
Use Again: During this time, he dashes toward an enemy hero, dealing 250 (+ 8% target's ) Physical Damage and knocking the target back for 1s.
Aldous can interrupt the target's Recall while dashing.
skills.notes: Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

story.biography:
The guardian of the Minoan Labyrinth.Combat Doctrine:
Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

Matchup Intelligence:
Aldous is strong against heroes who cannot pressure him in the early game, so that he can easily build up the damage buff for his 1st Skill. Such as Zilong and Leomord. Aldous is countered by heroes who are strong in the early game. They would make it very difficult for Aldous to build up the damage buff he needs. Heroes like Martis and Dyrroth are good examples here.
story.personality: Renowned Fighter specializing in Burst, Support across the EXP lane.
quotes: The guardian of the Minoan Labyrinth.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the EXP Lane.

build.tips: Aldous is strong against heroes who cannot pressure him in the early game, so that he can easily build up the damage buff for his 1st Skill. Such as Zilong and Leomord. Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

name: Claude
title: Partner in Crime
summary: Master thief accompanied by his monkey partner Dexter. Stacks Attack Speed and Movement Speed before hologram-blinking into teamfights with Blazing Duet.

skills.name: Battle Side-by-Side
skills.description: Dexter launches an additional attack each time Claude's Basic Attack lands, dealing 35% of Claude's Physical Attack and triggering a portion of on-hit attack effects.
skills.notes: Synergizes with Demon Hunter Sword (DHS), triggering percentage-HP shreds twice per shot.

skills.name: Art of Thievery
skills.description: Claude attacks enemies in a fan-shaped area, reducing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10%. For each enemy hit, Claude gains 4%–8% extra Movement & Attack Speed (up to 5 stacks for 6s).
skills.notes: Always keep 5 stacks of Art of Thievery active by tagging jungle creeps or lane minions before entering a fight.

skills.name: Battle Mirror Image
skills.description: Claude leaves a mirror image of Dexter at a designated location for 5.5s that automatically attacks nearby enemies. Cast again to swap places with the hologram.
skills.notes: Leave the hologram in a safe bush, blink in with Blazing Duet, and swap back out when enemies turn on you.

skills.name: Blazing Duet
skills.scaling: On-Hit DHS + Bonus Attack Speed Scaling
skills.description: Claude and Dexter unleash a rapid 3s barrage on up to 2 nearby enemies simultaneously, gaining a shield and firing faster based on Claude's extra Attack Speed.
skills.notes: Counts as Basic Attacks, meaning Golden Staff and Demon Hunter Sword proc on every bullet.

story.biography: Famous across the Agelta Drylands and the scientific metropolis of Eruditio as the King of Thieves, Claude always sends a calling card before his heists. After stealing Dr. Rooney's experimental holographic device in Eruditio, he gained the ability to project twin mirror images across the battlefield.
story.personality: Charismatic, cheeky, opportunistic, and fiercely loyal to his monkey sidekick Dexter.
quotes: Take it easy! I'm just borrowing this!
Dexter, did you smell gold?
They lock the doors, I walk through the window.

build.tips: Claude hits his massive power spike the moment he completes Demon Hunter Sword + Golden Staff.

name: Vale
title: The heir to Wind Fort, a wind mage.
summary: The heir to Wind Fort, a wind mage.

skills.name: Windtalk
skills.description: Vale gains 1 stack of Windtalk each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.
skills.notes: Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

skills.name: Wind Blade
skills.description: Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area, each dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.
skills.notes: Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

skills.name: Windblow
skills.description: Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, it will remain for 1.6s while continuously dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in range.
skills.notes: Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

skills.name: Windstorm
skills.description:
Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1s, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.
skills.notes: Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

story.biography:
The heir to Wind Fort, a wind mage.Combat Doctrine:
Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

Matchup Intelligence:
Vale counters slow Fighters like Terizla and Hilda because he can chip away their HP with his skills from afar while using his high Movement Speed to dodge their skills. Vale is countered by agile Assassins that can become untargetable like Hayabusa and Ling, as it will be difficult to catch them with his CC while they can eliminate Vale easily with their high damage.
story.personality: Renowned Mage specializing in Burst, Crowd Control across the Mid lane.
quotes: The heir to Wind Fort, a wind mage.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Mid Lane.

build.tips: Vale counters slow Fighters like Terizla and Hilda because he can chip away their HP with his skills from afar while using his high Movement Speed to dodge their skills. name: Leomord
title: A sworn knight who vowed to guard Necrokeep until hi...
summary: A sworn knight who vowed to guard Necrokeep until his last breath.

skills.name: The Oath Keeper
skills.description:
Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When the energy reaches 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100 (+10*Hero Level) (+15% Extra Max HP) HP.
Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage.
Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.description:
Leomord begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (scales with channeling time; increased to 140% against creeps except the Turtle and Lord) and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Use Again: Cast the skill again to cancel the channeling and immediately perform the thrust.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

skills.name: Decimation Assault
skills.description: Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

skills.name: Phantom Steed
skills.description:
Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path.
If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.
Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 70 Movement Speed and 30 . This lasts 10s.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

skills.name: Phantom Stomp
skills.description: Barbiel leaps forward, dealing 325 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the landing area and in front of him, while slowing them by 40% for 1s.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

skills.name: Phantom Charge
skills.description: Barbiel charges forward in a designated direction, and knocks back all enemies on the path, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

story.biography:
A sworn knight who vowed to guard Necrokeep until his last breath.Combat Doctrine:
Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

Matchup Intelligence:
Mages without mobility such as Odette, Pharsa, Yve and Cecilion will fall to Leomord's high movement speed and burst damage. Heroes with CC like Phoveus, Franco, Akai and Nana.
story.personality: Renowned Fighter specializing in Chase, Burst across the Jungle lane.
quotes: A sworn knight who vowed to guard Necrokeep until his last breath.
Victory belongs to the fearless on the Jungle Lane.

build.tips: Mages without mobility such as Odette, Pharsa, Yve and Cecilion will fall to Leomord's high movement speed and burst damage. Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

name: Lunox
title: A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.
summary: A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.

skills.name: Dreamland Twist
skills.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When she uses the Power of Order, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for every 1% Magic Penetration.
When she uses the Power of Chaos, she gains 0.5% Magic Penetration for every 1% Spell Vamp.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Starlight Pulse
skills.description:
Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each recovering 75 (+30% Total Magic Power) HP to her (doubled when hitting enemy heroes).

This skill shares a cooldown with Chaos Assault. It grants Power of Order and ends the Power of Chaos state.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Chaos Assault
skills.description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at a target enemy, dealing 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+ 2.5% target's ) Magic Damage (+ 1.5% against creeps).

This skill shares its cooldown with Starlight Pulse. Using it grants Power of Chaos and ends the Power of Order state.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Cosmic Fission
skills.description: Lunox channels the power of Order and Chaos in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 2s.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Order & Chaos
skills.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.

When Power of Order is dominant, she can cast Brilliance to become invincible and deal continuous damage to nearby enemies.
When Power of Chaos is dominant, she can cast Darkening to blink in a target direction and greatly reduce the cooldown of Chaos Assault for a brief period.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Chaos Assault
skills.description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at a target enemy, dealing 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+ 2.5% target's ) Magic Damage (+ 1.5% against creeps).

While enhanced by Power of Chaos, this skill has a brief cooldown, and its cast interval is unaffected by Cooldown Reduction.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Power of Order: Brilliance
skills.description: Lunox creates a Light Barrier, becoming invincible and untargetable for 2.5s, and gaining 30% Movement Speed. The barrier moves with her, dealing 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

skills.name: Power of Chaos: Darkening
skills.description:
Lunox blinks in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 4s.

For the next 4s, Lunox enhances her Power of Chaos, greatly reducing the cooldown of Chaos Assault (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Using Starlight Pulse ends this enhanced state.
skills.notes: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.Combat Doctrine:
Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

Lunox counters heroes that lack burst damage and healing, such as Yve and Lylia, because Lunox can use her self-healing to get the upper hand in a trade. quotes: A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.

name: Hanzo
title: Genius ninja in the Shadow Sect who is at the crossr...
summary: Genius ninja in the Shadow Sect who is at the crossroads.

skills.name: Ame no Habakiri
skills.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
skills.description:
The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
skills.description:
Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

skills.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
skills.description:
Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position.

While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, while Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed.

Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 360 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6s, and the skill's cooldown will be doubled.
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
skills.description:
Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases this damage by 20%. At max Dark Ninjutsu stacks, he deals 12 (+3% Extra Physical Attack)% target's extra damage (ignores 30% of target's ) and recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP.
This skill can be cast on the Turtle or Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Black Mist
skills.description:
Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4s and dealing 405 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage (recovers 200 Energy if hitting an enemy hero), leaving a Dark Mist in the area he passes through.
The mist deals 135 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%.

This damage is considered Basic Attack Damage, but cannot Crit.
skills.notes: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

Kimmy can keep moving while shooting and does not benefit from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed gained is converted to 1 .
Kimmy's Basic Attacks only deal 60% damage to Turrets.

skills.notes: Kimmy excels at controlling and grouping enemies while dealing substantial damage, so she works well with heroes who have AOE CC like Badang and Ruby.

name: Khufra
title: Desert Tyrant
summary: Ancient tyrant of the Agelta Drylands bound in cursed bandages. Launches across screen distances and transforms into a bouncing ball that knocks airborne any enemy attempting to dash.

quotes: The whole world shall be mine—except for her.
No one can escape my bandages!
Kneel before the ruler of the desert!

skills.name: Baxia Mark
skills.description:
Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1*Hero Level).
At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.
skills.notes: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

skills.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
skills.description:
Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.
skills.notes: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

skills.name: Shield of Spirit
skills.description:
Baxia throws out his shield, dealing 120 (+100% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's ) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.
skills.notes: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

skills.name: Tortoise’s Puissance
skills.description:
Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s.
For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 200%.
skills.notes: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

name: Masha
title: Guardian of the Direbears.
summary: Guardian of the Direbears.

skills.name: Primal Pact
skills.description:
Bear's Blessing: Masha has 3 HP bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. When an HP bar is depleted, she removes control effects and blocks damage once. She gains Feral by dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps. Feral converts into HP after leaving combat.
Power of Wildness: After Masha's skills deal damage to an enemy hero, she leaves a Wound in a random direction. Her Basic Attacks can break the Wound and cause her to enter the Feral state.
Feral: Masha gains 15 (+1*Hero Level)% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack) (+0.2*Hero Level)% extra Physical Damage to enemies in the area (extra damage does not apply to Turrets) and recovering 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% HP. It lasts 3s.
[C8Breaking a Wound again during the Feral state will refresh its duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.]
skills.notes: Masha also pairs well with CC heroes like Atlas and Minotaur. Once they pull the enemies together, she can tear them to shreds with her savage claws!

skills.name: Feral Swipe
skills.description:
Masha releases energy forward, dealing 250 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
If an enemy hero is hit, they are slowed by 50% for 1s.
skills.notes: Masha also pairs well with CC heroes like Atlas and Minotaur. Once they pull the enemies together, she can tear them to shreds with her savage claws!

skills.name: Claw Strike

Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
[C8Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of Claw Strike resets.]
skills.notes: Masha also pairs well with CC heroes like Atlas and Minotaur. Once they pull the enemies together, she can tear them to shreds with her savage claws!

skills.name: Savage Maul
skills.description: Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+50% Extra Max HP) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1s while knocking back nearby enemies.
skills.notes: Masha also pairs well with CC heroes like Atlas and Minotaur. Once they pull the enemies together, she can tear them to shreds with her savage claws!

skills.name: Tiger Pace
skills.description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.
skills.notes: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

skills.name: Swallow’s Path
skills.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.
skills.notes: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

skills.name: Needles in Flowers
skills.description: Wanwan removes all debuffs on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.
skills.notes: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

skills.name: Crossbow of Tang
skills.description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.
skills.notes: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

The bat also deals 170 (+140% Total Magic Power) (+14% Total Mana) extra Magic Damage to those near the landing point, and applies Overflowing effect once.

Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 Magic Damage (scales with level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

skills.name: Vampire Pact
skills.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6-13 (scales with level) from them. The stolen can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.
skills.notes: Carmilla is best paired with sustained damage Mages with CC abilities like Cecilion and Aurora, as her Ultimate can greatly amplify their strengths.

skills.name: Crimson Flower

Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 85 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%).

Carmilla recovers 45 (+21% Total Magic Power) HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

skills.name: Bloodbath

Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).
skills.notes: Carmilla is best paired with sustained damage Mages with CC abilities like Cecilion and Aurora, as her Ultimate can greatly amplify their strengths.

skills.name: Curse of Blood
skills.description:
Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s.

When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa will enhance Popol's next Basic Attack to deal (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% Total Physical Attack) and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and passive equipment effects (excluding Jungling and Roaming equipment effects).
Kupa deals an additional 120% damage against creeps.

Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

Enemies in the frost zone will have their Movement Speed reduced by 20%.
Popol gains a trap charge every 22s (up to 3). Up to 3 traps can exist at the same time on the battlefield, each lasting up to 60s.

name: Yu Zhong
title: Black Dragon
summary: Reincarnation of the primordial Black Dragon who drains enemy lifeforce with Sha Residue and transforms into a massive flying dragon to dive enemy backlines.

skills.name: Cursing Touch
skills.scaling: 2% Target Missing HP + 6% Lost HP Heal
skills.description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to targets every time he deals damage. At 5 stacks, Sha Residue erupts, consuming 1 stack every 0.5s to deal Physical Damage (+2% target's missing HP) and restoring 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP per eruption.
skills.notes: Hitting multiple heroes with Dragon Tail (S1) and Soul Grip (S2) triggers simultaneous Sha Residue healing streams.

skills.name: Dragon Tail
skills.description: Yu Zhong infuses power into his cloak and spins it after a short delay. The sharpened outer edge deals 250% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.
skills.notes: Space yourself so enemies stand on the glowing outer ring of the cloak spin.

skills.name: Soul Grip
skills.description: Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul wave, slowing enemies hit by 60% and enhancing his next Basic Attack to pull himself toward the target while applying up to 5 stacks of Sha Residue depending on targets hit.
skills.notes: Hitting a minion wave + enemy hero grants an instant 5-stack Sha Residue proc on the next Basic Attack.

skills.name: Furious Dive
skills.description: Yu Zhong leaps to a target area, dealing Physical Damage, then dashes once more in the movement direction. After a brief delay, enemies inside the circle are knocked airborne for 1s.
skills.notes: Pair Furious Dive with Petrify to guarantee enemies cannot dash out of the delayed knockup ring.

skills.name: Black Dragon Form
skills.description: Yu Zhong transforms into the Black Dragon for 7s, gaining CC immunity, ignoring terrain obstacles, and knocking back enemies in his flight path. Upon exiting Dragon form, he enters Dragonoid Form for 10s with expanded skill range and bonus Max HP.
skills.notes: Fly straight past the enemy frontline to zone out the enemy Marksman and Mage during Lord contests.

story.biography:
Rejecting the passive harmony preached by the Great Dragon of the Cadia Riverlands, Yu Zhong broke into the forbidden vaults to reclaim the Reverse Scale—the concentrated essence of the ancient Black Dragon.

Consumed yet victorious over the dragon's wrath, Yu Zhong seeks to unite the Cadia Riverlands under fierce dominion so it never bows to foreign threats.
story.personality: Domineering, visionary, ruthless in ambition, yet honorable to worthy warriors.
quotes: The Black Dragon has arrived!
I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me.
Harmony is a lie told by the weak.

talents: Brave Smite (HP Regen on Skill Hit)
build.tips: Oracle amplifies both Cursing Touch missing-HP regeneration and Festival of Blood spell vamp, making Yu Zhong nearly unkillable in 1v3 skirmishes.

name: Luo Yi
title: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the sole b...
summary: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the sole being who has mastered the secrets of Yin and Yang.

skills.name: Duality
skills.description:
Luo Yi's skills can create Sigils of Yin/Yang on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6s.
Sigils of opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction when they are within a certain distance, dealing 300 (+25*Hero Level) (+190% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the marked enemies, stunning them for 0.3s, and pulling them toward each other.
Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy, she gains a 300 (+10*Hero Level) (+150% Total Magic Power) shield (up to 3 stacks) and 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2s.
skills.notes: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

skills.name: Dispersion
skills.description:
Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang in the target direction, dealing 285 (+135% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and those behind them in a fan-shaped area. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Sigil of Yin/Yang.
Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8s. She also immediately gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction is triggered.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.
skills.notes: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

skills.name: Rotation
skills.description:
Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6s, dealing 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.7s to nearby enemies. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction with Sigils of opposite attributes.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.
skills.notes: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

skills.name: Diversion
skills.description:
Passive: Luo Yi's Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%.
Active: Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks the target location (within 28 units) as its destination. After a 3s delay, allied heroes within the Circle will be teleported to the location.
skills.notes: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the sole being who has mastered the secrets of Yin and Yang.Combat Doctrine:

quotes: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the sole being who has mastered the secrets of Yin and Yang.
