name: Benedetta
title: Female warrior defending the Barren Lands against de...
summary: Female warrior defending the Barren Lands against demon invasion.

skills.name: Elapsed Daytime
skills.description:
Hold the Basic Attack button to enter the Swordout state and charge Sword Intent. Once fully charged, release it to perform a Swordout Slash in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing (+215% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on the path (counts as basic attack damage and is reduced to 50% against minions and creeps).

Benedetta can only cast Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is full and she is in the Swordout state.

Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.
skills.notes: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

skills.name: Phantom Slash
skills.description:
Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5s.

Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%.)
skills.notes: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

skills.name: An Eye for An Eye
skills.description:
Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8s. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5s.
skills.notes: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

skills.name: Alecto: Final Blow
skills.description: Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay, detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5s, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560 (+1105% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and slows them by 50%.
skills.notes: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

story.biography:
Female warrior defending the Barren Lands against demon invasion.Combat Doctrine:
Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

Matchup Intelligence:
Benedetta's 2nd Skill can effectively block enemy CC, making her a great counter to heroes with predictable CC skills, such as Jawhead and Guinevere. Benedetta is countered by heroes with skills that shutdown mobility skills, such as Minsitthar and Phoveus, since all of Benedetta's skills are considered mobility.

quotes: Female warrior defending the Barren Lands against demon invasion.

name: Khaleed
title: A sand-walking intrepid Clan leader.

skills.name: Sand Walk
skills.description: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.
skills.notes: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

skills.name: Desert Tornado
skills.description:
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 175 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.

This skill deals 60% damage to Minions and Creeps.
skills.notes: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

skills.name: Quicksand Guard
skills.description:
Khaleed protects himself with quicksand, restoring HP equal to 60 + 5% of his and 10 Desert Power every 0.5s. He also gains 25% Damage Reduction for up to 4s.

While channeling, quicksand appears beneath him, slowing the enemy by 60%.
This is a Focused Cast. Other control effects will interrupt this skill.
skills.notes: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

skills.name: Raging Sandstorm
skills.description:
Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.

Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his Desert Power.
skills.notes: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

Khaleed counters heroes who lack mobility like Cyclops and Xavier since they will have difficult time avoiding his combo. Khaleed is countered by heroes who have the ability to knock him back or airborne to interrupt his 2nd Skill, such as X.Borg and Chou.

name: Barats
title: Adventurer riding a dragon lizard.
summary: Adventurer riding a dragon lizard.

skills.name: Big Guy
skills.description: Detona gains a stack of Big Guy for 12s each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Big Guy increases Detona's size and grants 4 - 10 (scales with the level of Detona's Welcome). At max stacks, Detona gains 20% extra Resilience, and its Basic Attacks are replaced with Trample, which deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+3.5% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2s, and refreshes the duration of Big Guy with each hit.
skills.notes: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

skills.name: So-Called Teamwork
skills.description:
Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60 (+7% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps).

The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.
skills.notes: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

skills.name: Missile "Expert"
skills.description: Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.
skills.notes: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

skills.name: Detona's Welcome
skills.description:
After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Max HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s, then spitting them out. If the spat‑out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies take an additional 180 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage and are stunned for 1s.

During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled or the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded.
If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of Big Guy.
skills.notes: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

Barats is countered by agile Marksmen who can deal high damage to Tanks, such as Karrie and Moskov, because Barats lacks mobility and his skills can be avoided, making these heroes very difficult to kill.

name: Brody
title: A ranger of the frontier with a right arm seeped in ...
summary: A ranger of the frontier with a right arm seeped in darkness, he channels pain into arrows to strike down invaders; he is the "Lone Star" that pierces the nights of the Barren Lands.

skills.name: Abyss Corrosion
skills.description:
With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attacks (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed Bonus. Each Basic Attack deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+45*Hero Level) Physical Damage (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2s), and applies 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks.
Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against the target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%.
skills.notes: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

skills.name: Abyss Impact
skills.description:
Brody launches a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 200 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.2s while applying one stack of Abyss Mark.

For each enemy hit by the shockwave, they take an extra 5% slow and one extra Abyss Mark stack (capped at 45% slow and 4 stacks).
skills.notes: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

skills.name: Corrosive Strike
skills.description:
Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, stunning the target for 0.8s, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the target.
Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2s.
skills.notes: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

skills.name: Torn-Apart Memory
skills.description:
Brody locks onto all enemies within 8 unit(s), dealing 216 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
For each target with Abyss Mark stacks, all stacks are consumed, dealing additional Physical Damage equal to 94 (+72% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 4% of the target's lost ) per stack.
skills.notes: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

skills.description: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s.
skills.notes: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.

skills.name: Void Blast
skills.description:
Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area.
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.
skills.notes: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.

skills.name: Void Crystal
skills.description:
Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 4% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).
skills.notes: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.

skills.name: Real World Manipulation
skills.description:
Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times.
Tap: Deals 340 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area.
Swipe: Deals 85 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

name: Mathilda
title: A brave girl who stands up and doesn't fear power.
summary: A brave girl who stands up and doesn't fear power.

skills.name: Ancestral Guidance
skills.description: Mathilda gains Ancestral Guidance while moving. When it's fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.
skills.notes: Mathilda works well with high burst damage heroes who can use Guiding Wind and follow up her Ultimate to secure kills, such as Saber and Eudora.

skills.name: Soul Bloom
skills.description:
Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps).

At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and revealing the enemies' positions briefly. Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.
skills.notes: Mathilda works well with high burst damage heroes who can use Guiding Wind and follow up her Ultimate to secure kills, such as Saber and Eudora.

skills.name: Guiding Wind
skills.description:
Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 350 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field will receive a 50% shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost.

When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda won't change her position.
Guiding Wind expires 2s after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with Soul Mark, dealing 320 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6s, transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne, and reducing the skill cooldown by 40%.

Paquito gains a stack each time he casts a skill. At 3 stacks, he enters the Champ Stance and enhances his next skill.
Paquito's enhanced skills have no cooldown and deal (+2*Hero Level)% extra damage to minions.

skills.name: Jab

Paquito dashes forward and throws a jab, dealing 200 (+165% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and at the destination.

The jab stops upon hitting a hero or creep.

Paquito launches an elbow strike at enemies in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back to the destination.

summary: A magical amalgamation of cute, mischievous creatures that dwells deep in the Shadow Swamp.

skills.name: Stick, Stick
skills.description:
Gloo's skills apply a stack of Sticky to enemies on hit, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s (up to 5 stacks).
Each Sticky stack on an attacker reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.
skills.notes: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

skills.name: Slam, Slam
skills.description:
Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.
A Goo is left at the end location, which explodes after 3s, dealing 250 (+12% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilizing them for 0.8s.
Touching the Goo detonates it immediately and resets this skill's cooldown. Gloo also recovers 2.5% if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).
skills.notes: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo charges toward it, dragging enemies in its path along for a distance.
skills.notes: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

skills.name: Grab, Grab

skills.notes: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

name: Beatrix
title: Dawnbreak Soldier
summary: Prodigy weaponsmith who carries four custom firearms—Renner (Sniper), Bennett (Grenade Launcher), Wesker (Shotgun), and Nibiru (Dual SMGs)—with four distinct Ultimates.

skills.name: Mechanical Genius

skills.notes: Extra Attack Speed reduces Beatrix's reload time.

skills.name: Masterful Gunner
skills.description: Beatrix swaps between her primary and secondary equipped weapons in 0.6s. Passively increases her Physical Attack with each skill level.
skills.notes: Fire Ultimate on Weapon A, immediately swap with S1, and fire the second Ultimate on Weapon B.

skills.name: Tactical Reposition
skills.description: Beatrix rolls forward in a target direction and immediately reloads her current weapon's magazine to full.
skills.notes: Empty your Nibiru or Wesker clip, dash with S2 for an instant reload, and fire a second full clip without delay.

skills.name: Renner's Apathy / Bennett's Rage / Wesker's Elation / Nibiru's Passion
skills.scaling: Up to 1100 (+280% Total Phy Atk) on Renner
skills.description: Unleashes the signature Ultimate of the currently held weapon: Long-range sniper assassination (Renner), large-area artillery bombardment (Bennett), close-range shotgun spread (Wesker), or cone SMG volley (Nibiru).
skills.notes: Each weapon pair tracks its own independent Ultimate cooldown!

story.biography: A brilliant yet rebellious engineering student in Eruditio, Beatrix clashed with the academic council over her radical neural-linked firearm designs. Guided by her AI butler Morgan, she built four modular weapons in her private laboratory and stepped onto the battlefield to defend Eruditio during the Abyssal invasion.
story.personality: Inventive, confident, impatient with bureaucracy, and obsessed with precision hardware.
quotes: Four weapons, four ways to win.
Morgan, calibrate the wind speed!
The scholars talk; my guns act.

build.tips: Equip Nibiru (SMG) + Bennett (Grenade) for teamfights and fast waveclear, or Renner (Sniper) + Wesker (Shotgun) for bush ambushes.

Aulus starts accumulating Fighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity.

name: Aamon
title: Duke of Shards
summary: Noble Duke of House Paxley and Gusion's older brother. Enters untargetable Camouflage state after every spell, healing and charging Demonic Blades for a lethal Endless Shards execution.

skills.name: Invisible Armor
skills.description: Aamon enters a Camouflage state each time he hits an enemy with a skill (or casts Slayer Shards), becoming untargetable by Basic Attacks and targeted spells, restoring HP every 0.6s, and gaining 60% decaying Movement Speed. Attacking breaks Camouflage with an empowered Magic Basic Attack that reduces skill cooldowns.
skills.notes: Poke with Skill 1 or Skill 2 to stack shards on the ground before unleashing Endless Shards.

skills.notes: Low cooldown tool to stay permanently camouflaged while rotating between jungle camps.

skills.description: Aamon throws a shard forward that slows the first enemy hit by 50% for 2s and boomerangs back to him, immediately placing Aamon into Camouflage even if it hits nothing.
skills.notes: Use Slayer Shards to engage from afar or escape over vision.

skills.name: Endless Shards
skills.scaling: Up to 25 Shards (Scales with Target Missing HP)
skills.description: Aamon throws all shards stored in his armor and lying on the ground at a designated enemy (from 8 up to 25 shards). After a brief delay, the shards fly to the target's location, dealing Magic Damage that increases up to 150% based on the target's lost HP.
skills.notes: Wait until you have 20+ shards stacked from S1/S2 + Empowered Basic Attack before pressing Ultimate.

story.biography: As the eldest heir and young Duke of House Paxley, Aamon shoulders the dark secrets and political burdens of Castle Aberleen. Though forced by family elders to pursue his rebellious younger brother Gusion, Aamon secretly destroyed the elders' blood-curse scrolls to spare Gusion's life.
story.personality: Composed, aristocratic, calculating, and quietly protective of his younger brother.
quotes: It is better to be feared than loved, if you cannot be both.
Gusion always follows his heart; someone must guard the house.
House Paxley will shine under my command.

build.tips: Feather of Heaven lets Aamon weave ultra-fast empowered Basic Attacks out of Camouflage to drop 5 shards on the ground in 1 second.

skills.name: Siphon Starlium
skills.description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. Siphon Starlium can hit all enemies in front of Ixia within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

Control effects can affect Kalea during the third Enhanced Basic Attack, but cannot interrupt it.
skills.notes: Kalea's strong single-target CC makes her work well with heroes who have high single-target burst, like Eudora, Harley, and Clint.

The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

Killing an enemy hero directly grants 1 Bone Shard(s).
Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 100% Attack Effects.
